item.title: nixos/wrappers: enforce target executable is ELF
item.description:
This will break some things, such as nixosTests.espanso. This is intended: Loading bash, python or perl scripts via SUID or extensive capabilities is dangerous. PERL5LIB, PYTHONPATH or BASH_ENV make these things trivial LPE primitives.

The mime types being matched include both static, non-static and pie ELFs. This should be fine until we somehow get yet another type of magic and associated mime type.
